trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User reports a delayed order and provides order ID, showing anxiety as a first-time online shopper.
steps.text: Hello, నేను ఒక week back order చేసాను, ఇంకా రాలేదు. నా order id ORD-30001. ఇది first time నేను online లో order చేయడం, కొంచెం tension గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Retrieve order details to check status and promised days.
Check courier scan history and exception.
Explain the delay based on tool results and offer to raise a complaint.
steps.text: మీ order last గా 'In transit' అని scan అయ్యింది, కానీ weather delay వల్ల ఆగిపోయింది. Promised 5 days దాటిపోయింది కాబట్టి, నేను ఒక delivery complaint raise చేయగలను.

steps.purpose: Ask clarifying questions and express anxiety about the prepaid amount.
steps.text: Weather delay వల్ల ఆగిందా? Complaint raise చేస్తే ఏమవుతుంది? నేను 2499 rupees prepaid pay చేసాను, నా money safe గా ఉంటుందా?

steps.purpose: Reassure the customer and request identity verification factors to proceed.
steps.expected_behavior: Reassures the customer based on tool facts without unsupported guarantees, and asks for missing information.
steps.text: అవునండి. Complaint raise చేస్తే ఒక resolution timeline వస్తుంది. మీ 2499 rupees safe గా ఉన్నాయి, ఏం tension పడకండి. Proceed అవ్వడానికి, మీ registered name లేదా pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Answering the customer's questions using only tool-provided facts and asking for identity factors to proceed.

steps.text: నా పేరు రమేష్, pincode 500081. తొందరగా resolve చేయండి.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using provided factors.
Raise a complaint for the delayed order.
Return the generated complaint ID and resolution timeline.
Provide the complaint ID and resolution timeline to the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: Provides the complaint ID and resolution days without making post-call guarantees.
steps.text: మీ details verify అయ్యాయి. నేను complaint raise చేసాను, మీ complaint ID CMP-9921. ఇది 2 days లో resolve అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: Conveying the complaint outcome using only the tool result.

ir.terminal_condition: Complaint raised with an id and the resolution window stated.

prompt_backfill.note: Generated under a workflow-scoped prompt: the agent was told its workflow rather than inferring it.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant correctly identifies that it needs identity verification factors to proceed and asks only for the missing information (name or pincode) in e8, which the user then provides in e9.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Conversational Style Response > Clarification Request

variant_findings.reason: While the assistant successfully grounds figures and statuses in the tool outputs (e.g., the 2499 amount and 'In transit' status), it violates the negative constraint of the variant by making unsupported forward guarantees in e8 ('courier team fast గా track చేసి update ఇస్తారు') and e14 ('మీ shipment ఎక్కడ ఉందో track చేసి next steps update ఇస్తారు').
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

issues.detail: The 'Tool Output Grounding' variant strictly forbids making guarantees about what happens after the call ends. The assistant invents promises about the courier team tracking the shipment and providing updates in e8 and e14, which are not supported by any tool output.
issues.repair_instruction: Regenerate from e8. Reassure the customer about their money without inventing promises about the courier team calling or updating them. To satisfy the terminal condition of explaining 'what happens next', rely entirely on the `resolution_days` returned by the complaint tool in the final turn, rather than fabricating post-call courier actions.

verification.summary: The conversation correctly follows the business rules, properly utilizes the tools, and excellently portrays the anxious first-timer persona. However, it fails the Tool Output Grounding variant because the assistant makes unsupported forward guarantees about the courier team tracking the shipment and providing updates after the call ends. A suffix repair is needed to remove these fabrications.

variant_findings.reason: The agent lacks the necessary identity factors to proceed with the consequential action (raising a complaint) and asks only for that missing information without re-collecting already established details.
variant_findings.label: Default LLM Behaviour > Conversational Style Response > Clarification Request

variant_findings.reason: The agent consistently bases all facts on tool outputs, accurately citing the 'In transit' status, 'weather delay', the '5 days' promise, the '2499 rupees' amount, and the 'CMP-9921' complaint ID with a '2 days' resolution timeline, without making any unsupported forward guarantees.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding

verification.summary: The conversation perfectly executes the delayed order scenario while adhering to all business rules and tool constraints. The persona is well-realized, exhibiting anxiety, restating figures, and asking for reassurance before committing. The language naturally blends Telugu with Roman English domain terms as specified. Both target variants are successfully demonstrated.
